1. claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 retires on the Claude API Nov 30, 2026; use claude-sonnet-5-5 (model-retirement, effective 2026-11-30)

This is optional and has no deadline, but it is the route to the current API. The task bumps the SDK and fixes what the bump breaks: sampling params in the SDK call sites, MessageParam typing, and the OpenTelemetry default noted above. The Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry note does not apply because the repo uses the direct SDK. Raw-HTTP usage 1 is not touched by this bump and is handled in the API-version task.

Same header and body check.); scripts/generate-ekyc-chunks.js:60 (Raw POST /v1/messages. Same header and body check.); scripts/seed-cache.js:117 (Raw POST /v1/messages. Same header and body check.); scripts/seed-umang-chunks.js:108 (Raw POST /v1/messages. Same header and body check.)
   Why it applies: Nine files call POST /v1/messages over raw HTTP, so the anthropic-version header is set by the repo, not by an SDK. Those calls stay on 2023-06-01 (presumably) and keep working, so this is a planned move, not a break. If the repo moves to 2026-10-21, the migration agent must bump the header at every call site and strip temperature, top_p and top_k. It must also check for document blocks in assistant messages and citations on user text blocks. The request bodies and the header were not read, so what the agent must verify is the current header value and whether any body uses those fields. The Admin API renames in the same version do not apply.

record.prBody:
## 3 changes: claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 retires on the Claude API Nov 30, 2026; use claude-sonnet-5-5 and more [Verified]

### Change

Replaced claude-sonnet-4-5 with claude-sonnet-5-5 in all 12 JS files (SDK calls, raw-HTTP calls, the SONNET constant and cache metadata). Added test/model.test.js. No sampling params, tool_choice or thinking:disabled found. The SDK bump to 1.0.0 and the anthropic-version bump to 2026-10-21 were NOT done: they are optional, and the retirement needs neither.

Files touched:
- `api/ekyc-chunk.js`
- `api/journey-chunk.js`
- `api/klh-script.js`
- `api/umang-chunk.js`
- `demo/server.js`
- `demo/server_old.js`
- `scripts/generate-cache.js`
- `scripts/generate-chunks.js`
- `scripts/generate-ekyc-chunks.js`
- `scripts/seed-cache.js`
- `scripts/seed-umang-chunks.js`
- `src/rhetorical.js`
- `test/model.test.js`

### Why

claude-sonnet-4-5 (alias of 20250929) retires 2026-11-30; requests fail after that.

> | November 30, 2026 | `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929` | `claude-sonnet-5-5` |

Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations.md

### Proof

| Check | Before | After | New failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| model-test | fail (1) | pass | 0 |

New failures: 0

Checks added by the agent (they count toward proof; check that each command really tests the change):
- model-test, added by the agent: `node test/model.test.js` (fail (1) → pass)

Provider validators: none run.

Test of this change: `model-test`, written by the agent and run with the checks.

Where checks ran: Docker container node:22-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy; no credentials, so no live API calls

### Unproven

- SDK 0.82.0 not checked against the new model
- Cached backup data still names the old model
- Raw-HTTP calls remain on anthropic-version 2023-06-01 and SDK remains 0.82.0 (changes 2 and 3 need no change; no temperature/top_p/top_k in repo)
- No provider validator was run.

### Behaviour changes

- Output tone, length, JSON adherence, cost and latency may differ with Sonnet 5.5; spot-check generated scripts
- New cache entries are labelled model claude-sonnet-5-5

---

preparation.reasoning: No checks were detected and package.json has no build, codegen, postinstall or prepare scripts. The cache generation scripts call live services (Anthropic, Upstash) and are not setup steps, so nothing needs to run.

review.summary: The diff swaps the old model string for claude-sonnet-5-5 at every named Anthropic call site, and the model-test passes. I could not confirm the identifier from memory. The quoted retirement table lists claude-sonnet-5-5 as the replacement, so that is the source to check. Beyond the rename, the change has gaps. The new model's behaviour and cost are unchecked. The PR also relies on a source-grep test that cannot catch runtime breakage. api/klh-script.js contains unresolved merge-conflict markers, which break the file whatever the model name is. That predates this change, but it means the 'verified' grade overstates what was shown. Another thing the diff leaves out is cached entries: the 'model' metadata field changes in several cache writes, which is harmless.

concerns.issue: The file contains unresolved merge-conflict markers (<<<<<<< HEAD, =======, >>>>>>>). It is not valid JavaScript and would fail to parse or deploy. This predates the PR, but the edited lines sit inside this file, so the edit cannot be verified here and the 'verified' grade is questionable. The model-test passes only because it greps text and never imports the file.

The test is a text grep: it checks that no file contains the old string and that at least 10 files contain the new one. It never calls the API, parses the files, or exercises a handler, so it cannot show that claude-sonnet-5-5 is accepted or that responses keep the same shape. Its n<10 threshold is arbitrary. It also skips the test directory and dot-folders, and only scans .js files, so HTML or JSON configs with the old string would go unnoticed. The 'forbidden param' regex is not tied to anything in the diff.

The SONNET constant now points at the new model and is used in generateDim, liveAnswer and the cacheSet model field. The Hindi, Devanagari-only output and the max_tokens limits (400 to 1200) are unchanged. Behaviour on the new model, such as output length, script purity and latency, is unverified. Tier-1 cached content was generated by the old model, so cached and live answers may now differ in tone, and the tier comparison demo could be affected.
Two calls in a file named _old were updated. If the file is dead code, the change is harmless but unnecessary. If it is live, the change is needed. Confirm whether it is still used.

checkFirst: Confirm in the quoted deprecations page (platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations.md) and the models list that claude-sonnet-5-5 is a valid API model ID, and that it accepts the same parameters (max_tokens, messages) with the same response shape (content[0].text).
Resolve the merge-conflict markers in api/klh-script.js and confirm the file parses (node --check) before merging.

Run one live call per distinct code path (api/journey-chunk.js, api/umang-chunk.js, src/rhetorical.js, demo/server.js) against the new model and check that the Devanagari-only output and JSON-only output in src/rhetorical.js still hold.
Check for other references to the old model outside .js files (HTML, JSON, env/config, vercel settings, docs) since the test scans only .js files.
Confirm the date-less alias 'claude-sonnet-4-5' was covered by the retirement entry (the quoted row names claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929), and review pricing or rate-limit differences for the new model.
